assessor: Equipo de Seguridad de la Informacion
scope: Sistema de Gestion de Seguridad de la Informacion (SGSI) - Todas las ubicaciones

requirements.name: Policies for information security
requirements.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.
requirements.evidence: Politica general aprobada v2.1 (marzo 2024). Politicas especificas de acceso, clasificacion, backup, incidentes documentadas. Revision programada para marzo 2025.
requirements.gaps: La revision programada para marzo 2025 no se ha ejecutado (3 meses de retraso).

requirements.name: Information security roles and responsibilities
requirements.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.
requirements.evidence: Comite de Seguridad constituido con 5 roles definidos (CISO, Oficial de Cumplimiento, Lider Tecnico, Rep. RRHH, Rep. Legal). Matriz RACI documentada.

requirements.name: Management responsibilities
requirements.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy and topic-specific policies of the organization.
requirements.evidence: Clausulas de seguridad en contratos laborales. Capacitacion obligatoria anual. Proceso disciplinario documentado.
requirements.gaps: 2 contratistas de outsourcing no han firmado anexo de seguridad del SGSI.

requirements.name: Inventory of information and other associated assets
requirements.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
requirements.evidence: Inventario de activos de TI en CMDB (ServiceNow). Inventario de informacion parcial por area.
requirements.gaps: Inventario de activos de informacion incompleto. Falta clasificacion formal para 40% de los repositorios de datos. No se han identificado propietarios para 15 bases de datos legacy.

requirements.name: Classification of information
requirements.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.
requirements.evidence: Esquema de clasificacion de 3 niveles (Confidencial, Interno, Publico). Procedimiento de etiquetado documentado.
requirements.gaps: Etiquetado inconsistente en repositorios Git. 60% de documentos en SharePoint sin clasificacion explicita.

requirements.name: Access control
requirements.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
requirements.evidence: Politica de acceso documentada. Principio de minimo privilegio. MFA para sistemas criticos. Revision trimestral de accesos privilegiados.
requirements.gaps: 8 cuentas con privilegios excesivos identificadas en revision Q4 2024 no remediadas. 3 cuentas de ex-empleados activas 15-30 dias post-baja.

requirements.name: Information security in supplier relationships
requirements.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.
requirements.evidence: Cuestionario de seguridad para proveedores. Evaluacion anual. Clausulas contractuales de seguridad.
requirements.gaps: Proveedor DataGuard MX sin evidencia de destruccion certificada para Q3 2024. NDA con VerificaMX vencido.

requirements.name: Information security incident management planning and preparation
requirements.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.
requirements.evidence: Proceso de gestion de incidentes documentado con 4 niveles de severidad. Roles definidos. Canales de reporte activos. 7 incidentes gestionados en el periodo.
requirements.gaps: Incidente P1 de noviembre 2024 excedio SLA significativamente (48h vs 15min).

requirements.name: Information security during disruption
requirements.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
requirements.evidence: BCP documentado con RTO/RPO por servicio. Ejercicios tabletop semestrales. Sitio DR en us-west-2.
requirements.gaps: DR del ERP nunca probado. RTO de 12 horas no validado. No existe plan para falla electrica prolongada (>4h).

requirements.name: Documented operating procedures
requirements.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
requirements.evidence: Procedimientos operativos en Confluence: backup, parchado, monitoreo, gestion de cambios. Revisados anualmente.
requirements.gaps: Procedimiento de respaldo de ERP desactualizado (ultima revision hace 18 meses).

requirements.name: Screening
requirements.description: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.
requirements.evidence: Proceso de verificacion de 5 pasos documentado. 92.8% de cumplimiento (26/28 contrataciones).
requirements.gaps: 2 empleados contratados sin verificacion completa en diciembre 2024 (urgencia de proyecto). Verificacion completada post-contratacion.

requirements.name: Information security awareness, education and training
requirements.description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.
requirements.evidence: Programa anual de capacitacion. Simulaciones de phishing trimestrales con tendencia positiva. Induccion de seguridad para nuevos.
requirements.gaps: Capacitacion anual al 81.7% (meta 95%). Capacitacion especializada de desarrollo seguro al 62.8%. Sin modulo de trabajo remoto seguro.

requirements.name: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
requirements.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.
requirements.evidence: Checklist de offboarding documentado. NDAs con vigencia post-empleo de 2 anos.
requirements.gaps: Offboarding completo en SLA solo 73.3%. Accesos cloud no revocados mismo dia en 4/15 bajas. Cuenta AWS activa 23 dias post-salida. Entrevista de salida con seguridad solo 70%.

requirements.name: Remote working
requirements.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.
requirements.evidence: Politica de trabajo remoto aprobada. VPN corporativa. Cifrado de disco 100%. EDR en todos los endpoints.
requirements.gaps: Sin verificacion tecnica de uso continuo de VPN (8 conexiones directas detectadas). Sin MDM completo (40% sin borrado remoto). Sin auditoria fisica de espacio remoto. Sin control tecnico para prohibir redes publicas.

requirements.name: Physical security perimeters
requirements.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
requirements.evidence: 3 ubicaciones con controles perimetrales: CDMX (alto), GDL (medio-alto), MTY (medio). CCTV y alarmas en CDMX.
requirements.gaps: MTY: Sin control de acceso al piso fuera de horario. GDL: Alarma perimetral depende de proveedor de edificio sin SLA.

requirements.name: Physical entry controls
requirements.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.
requirements.evidence: Sistemas de control de acceso en 3 ubicaciones (RFID, biometrico, PIN+tarjeta). Registro de visitantes.
requirements.gaps: 5 tarjetas activas sin personal vigente. MTY sin credencial de visitante. GDL no integrado con RRHH automaticamente.

requirements.name: Physical security monitoring
requirements.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
requirements.evidence: CCTV en 3 ubicaciones (24 camaras total). Monitoreo en tiempo real solo en CDMX.
requirements.gaps: MTY: 1 camara fuera de servicio 43 dias sin reparacion. GDL: Sin monitoreo en tiempo real. MTY: Retencion de solo 7 dias insuficiente.

requirements.name: Clear desk and clear screen
requirements.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
requirements.evidence: Politica documentada. Bloqueo automatico a 5 min. Inspecciones sorpresa trimestrales.
requirements.gaps: Tasa de violaciones del 18.3% persistente. 2 casos de contrasenas en notas adhesivas. Sin consecuencias formales para reincidentes.

requirements.name: Security of assets off-premises
requirements.description: Off-site assets shall be protected.
requirements.evidence: Cifrado de disco 100%. Telefonos con borrado remoto. Politica de uso fuera de oficina.
requirements.gaps: 40% de laptops sin MDM (sin borrado remoto ni rastreo). 2 tablets extraviadas sin posibilidad de wipe. Sin control efectivo sobre copias locales.

requirements.name: Storage media
requirements.description: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organization's classification scheme and handling requirements.
requirements.evidence: Proceso de ciclo de vida documentado. Destruccion certificada para HDD y servidores retirados.
requirements.gaps: 6 SSD de laptops retiradas sin procesar para destruccion (2 meses en espera). Sin certificado de destruccion de DataGuard para documentos Q3 2024.

requirements.name: Information access restriction
requirements.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
requirements.evidence: RBAC implementado parcialmente. Politica de acceso documentada.
requirements.gaps: IDOR critico en API de reportes (acceso a reportes de otros usuarios sin autorizacion). Endpoint administrativo /api/admin/config sin autenticacion. Cuentas privilegiadas excesivas sin remediacion.

requirements.name: Secure authentication
requirements.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established and implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
requirements.evidence: MFA implementado para sistemas criticos. Politica de contrasenas de 12 caracteres.
requirements.gaps: JWT acepta algoritmo 'none' (permite forjado de tokens). Username enumeration via timing. MFA sin rate limiting. Password minimo de 4 caracteres en portal SGSI. python-jose vulnerable a confusion de algoritmo.

requirements.name: Protection against malware
requirements.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
requirements.evidence: CrowdStrike Falcon EDR en todos los endpoints. Escaneo de email. Restriccion de ejecucion de scripts.
requirements.gaps: Endpoint de upload acepta archivos ejecutables sin validacion de contenido. Archivos subidos almacenados en directorio accesible publicamente y ejecutable por web server.

requirements.name: Configuration management
requirements.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
requirements.evidence: Configuraciones de infraestructura en IaC (Terraform/CDK). Hardening baselines para servidores.
requirements.gaps: Debug mode activo en produccion. Security headers faltantes. Cookie session sin atributos Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite. CORS permite todos los origenes.

requirements.name: Data leakage prevention
requirements.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.
requirements.evidence: Politica de DLP documentada. Monitoreo basico de transferencias >100MB.
requirements.gaps: Token de autenticacion expuesto en URL (visible en logs, browser history, Referer). Sin herramienta DLP efectiva (identificado en post-mortem de incidente nov 2024). Sin control tecnico para prevenir copias a dispositivos personales.

requirements.name: Logging
requirements.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
requirements.evidence: Logs centralizados en CloudWatch (1 ano retencion). Alertas automaticas para eventos criticos. Revision semanal.
requirements.gaps: Datos sensibles (email, IP) en logs sin enmascarar. Error responses exponen stack traces y info interna. Sin SIEM completo para correlacion avanzada. Credenciales AWS potencialmente loggeadas en debug.

requirements.name: Use of cryptography
requirements.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
requirements.evidence: Cifrado en reposo (AES-256) y transito (TLS). BitLocker/FileVault en endpoints.
requirements.gaps: MD5 usado para hashing de passwords. TLS 1.0/1.1 habilitados con cipher suites debiles (RC4, 3DES). Session token con random debil. Verificacion TLS deshabilitada en HTTP client. Terrapin vulnerability en SSH (paramiko).

requirements.name: Secure development life cycle
requirements.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
requirements.evidence: SonarQube integrado en CI/CD. Code review obligatorio. OWASP ZAP en pipeline.
requirements.gaps: Security rating E en SonarQube. Cookies sin atributos seguros. Capacitacion en desarrollo seguro al 62.8%. Dependencias con vulnerabilidades criticas no parcheadas (Django, Pillow, cryptography).

requirements.name: Application security requirements
requirements.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
requirements.evidence: Requisitos de seguridad definidos en plantilla de proyecto. Pruebas SAST/DAST en pipeline.
requirements.gaps: 18 vulnerabilidades en SonarQube (6 criticas/altas sin remediar). SQL injection, XSS reflejado y almacenado, path traversal, SSRF, CSRF sin proteccion. 11 alertas OWASP ZAP incluyendo 4 altas. 23 dependencias vulnerables sin actualizar.

requirements.name: Secure coding
requirements.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
requirements.evidence: Guia de desarrollo seguro publicada. SonarQube en CI. Code review.
requirements.gaps: SQL injection directa en login.py. Hardcoded credentials en codigo. Input sin sanitizar. Deserialization insegura con pickle. Unsafe YAML load. Request smuggling en gunicorn. Buffer overflow en Pillow.
